alarm_permissions_modal.title: Critical Alarm Guarantee
alarm_permissions_modal.subtitle: Ensure Veyra wakes the screen and rings at full volume even when your device is locked or in deep sleep.
alarm_permissions_modal.diagnostic_channels_active: Priority audio channels: Configured with Do Not Disturb Bypass
alarm_permissions_modal.fullscreen_desc: Allows Veyra to automatically wake the display and present the full confirmation card when a critical alarm rings.
alarm_permissions_modal.fullscreen_action_info: What does this button do? Opens Android system settings. You must turn on the 'Allow full screen' toggle for Veyra.
alarm_permissions_modal.fullscreen_destination: Opens: Android Settings > Special App Access > Full Screen
alarm_permissions_modal.battery_desc: Prevents Android from killing Veyra in the background or freezing its alarms when the phone has been idle for hours.
alarm_permissions_modal.battery_action_info: What does this button do? Opens the Android system prompt. Select 'Unrestricted' (or 'Allow') to ignore battery optimizations.
alarm_permissions_modal.battery_destination: Opens: System Prompt > Ignore Battery Optimization
alarm_permissions_modal.exact_desc: Forces the operating system to wake the app at the exact scheduled second, without battery-saving delays.
alarm_permissions_modal.exact_action_info: What does this button do? Takes you to Android alarm settings. You must enable 'Allow setting alarms and reminders'.
alarm_permissions_modal.exact_destination: Opens: Android Settings > Alarms and Reminders
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_xiaomi_title: Key setting for Xiaomi / POCO / Redmi (MIUI / HyperOS)
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_xiaomi_desc: MIUI and HyperOS require special permissions to allow screen wake-up:
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_xiaomi_step1: 1. Go to 'Other permissions' and enable 'Show on Lock screen'.
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_xiaomi_step2: 2. Enable 'Display pop-up windows while running in background'.
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_xiaomi_step3: 3. In 'Autostart', ensure it is toggled ON for Veyra.
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_samsung_title: Key setting for Samsung One UI
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_samsung_desc: One UI includes aggressive battery modes that must be configured:
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_samsung_step2: 2. In 'Notifications', verify pop-up alerts are allowed.
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_samsung_step3: 3. If 'Appear on top' is listed, keep it enabled.
alarm_permissions_modal.manufacturer_general_desc: Access Veyra's system info page to review notification, sound, and background permissions.
alarm_permissions_modal.test_desc: Verify with 100% confidence that everything is working properly.
alarm_permissions_modal.test_instructions:
1. Tap the green button.
2. Immediately press your phone's physical power button to TURN OFF the screen.
3. Wait 5 seconds: the screen should turn on by itself and ring.
alarm_permissions_modal.test_scheduled: Alarm scheduled in 5 seconds! Lock your screen with the power button NOW.

help.title: Help & Support

faqs.a1:
Control levels determine how persistent the app is with your reminders:

• Normal: A single notification.
• Strict: Notification + 2 reminders every 15 minutes.
• Critical: Notification + 5 reminders every 5 minutes with intense sound and vibration.
faqs.a2: Yes, you can change the control level of any reminder to "Normal" by editing it. You can also adjust global settings in Settings.
faqs.q3: What happens if I delete a reminder?
faqs.a3: When you delete a reminder, it's automatically canceled and marked as "failed" in your history. This affects your compliance rate.
faqs.a4: Strict Mode temporarily turns ALL your reminders to "Strict" level and can block snoozing based on your settings.
faqs.a5: Currently you can see your full history in the History section. The CSV export feature will be available soon.
